references.name: Lichtblick
references.pattern: Native mosaic panels, shared playback clock, 3D transforms and configurable plots form a robotics analysis workstation. Actual source and runtime inspected.
references.tradeoff: The native engine is a substantial desktop-oriented bundle; reusing it does not validate physical robot data.

comparisons.gap: The previous dashboard lacked native docking and a shared analysis runtime.
comparisons.improvement: Reuse the actual native engine and keep data-source provenance explicit.
comparisons.not_copied: No Foxglove proprietary code, branding or sensor recordings were copied.

design_system.body_font: Native Inter UI and IBM Plex Mono technical values, retained from Lichtblick
design_system.arabic_font: English native UI in this milestone; Arabic/RTL has not been accepted
design_system.illustration_policy: No decorative marketing illustrations. Licensed CAD and geometric paths explain robot frames; original Garden is absent and not substituted silently.
design_system.density_rationale: Native docking separates Perception, Planning, Controls, Diagnostics and Missions; inspectors open progressively and the native playback bar remains shared.

design_directions.layout: Retain the previous long HTML dashboard with independently rendered widgets; rejected by the owner.
Vendor and run the actual native Lichtblick docking and playback engine with a thin Delivery workspace layer.

review.decision_reason: The owner explicitly prefers genuine code reuse and professional analysis behavior; native docking and shared playback avoid reconstructing another imitation.
review.task_test_evidence: Actual production Chromium playback, decoded world-position changes, play/pause/seek, keyboard toggle, native panel resizing/addition, workspace and reload persistence, 1024px playback, missing-source error and empty Missions state. See browser-results.json. Robot visibility was separately inspected in the saved screenshots.
